subject: [PATCH v6 2/2] iommu/arm-smmu-v3: Default queue depths to one page in a kdump kernel

2026-09-09.patch_summary: This patch modifies the default queue depths in a kdump kernel to one page, reducing memory usage and conserving resources in capture kernels. The change affects three queues: command (cmdq), event (evtq), and priority (priq). In normal operation, these queues are sized based on hardware advertisements and allocated at probe time. However, in a kdump kernel, the default queue depths are reduced to one page when is_kdump_kernel() returns true. This change does not impact dump throughput as the queues primarily carry commands and fault records rather than DMA data. An explicit cmdq_max_n_shift parameter still allows users to request deeper command queues if needed.
